notes:
EmStat Control is now part of LacBench, with BathBot. LacBench 0.2.0: EmStat Control and BathBot in one download.
- EmStat Control: the same app, now with a red strip while recording, quieter marker lines, and the update reminder covering the whole bundle.
- Windows: the EmStat is found as PSTrace finds it, also when the driver gives it no COM port (listed as usb:<serial>). The apps no longer crash on start with some Intel graphics drivers. The files are EmStat Control.exe and BathBot.exe.
- New: BathBot (preview, not yet tried on the arm). A Dobot MG400 moves one sensor through MDB100 dry-bath wells during one EmStat CA recording. Build a program from wells, loops, waits and pauses; markers are set at the bottom of each well and as the sensor leaves it.
